messages:
Maria C: Quick sync — rolling Citrine-2B into the catalog. Question for owners: do we have licensing sign-off from Legal and a perf profile ready? Need ETA for a canary by EOD Wed. cc @Josh R @Sophia L
Josh R: Legal gave the go-ahead on the license type (Apache-2.0 variant). They asked for an SPDX line in the manifest; I can add it today.
Sophia L: Perf run kicked off in staging. p90 latency looks fine on p3.2xlarge but throughput is unstable across runs. I'll attach the CSV shortly. I see KV-cache warmup noise.
Liam T: Heads up — infra can't guarantee dedicated canary slots before Thu due to prior bookings. We can still run a smoke canary on shared staging if that helps.
Maria C: Shared staging is OK for validation as long as we can reproduce steady-state perf. Josh — can you add the SPDX manifest change? Sophia — can you paste the probe command + a CSV head here when ready?
Josh R: Done, pushed manifest change: ```spdx_license: Apache-2.0
license_source: legal/citrine-2b.pdf```
Sophia L: Probe command: ```python -m perf_runner --model citrine-2b --seq 512 --batch 8 --kv-cache true``` CSV head: `p90_ms,p50_ms,throughput_tps
102,48,12.4` — looks OK initially but throughput drops after warmup on longer runs.
Maria C: Noted. @Liam T can you add a short autoscaler override to keep instances warm for the canary window (suggested config: min_replicas:2)?
Liam T: On it. Applying k8s override now: ```kubectl apply -f citrine-canary-override.yaml``` Should be active in ~10m.
catalog-bot: Model manifest 'citrine-2b' added to staging catalog by Josh R. Link: https://catalog/staging/citrine-2b
Maria C: Plan for now — Josh finalizes SPDX (done), Sophia validates extended perf after warmup, Liam enables override. If all green we target canary Thu 09:00 PST. I'll file the rollout ticket and leave blockers here.
Josh R: I'll also ping infra-schedule in case we need to free a dedicated slot later.
Sophia L: Running an extended (30m) perf now. Will post updated CSV and call out any regressions. If the throughput dip is KV-cache related I'll try a priming step.
Maria C: Thanks team :thumbsup:
Maria C: small add — include one sample prompt set for smoke testing structured output (QA + summarization) so SREs can run deterministic checks.
Sophia L: Added prompt set to PR, and included the smoke test script. PR: https://github.com/redwood/catalog/pull/1234
